---
title: "How do canard glide ratio and trim drag compare with the baseline?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 42.8      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Evaluate canard configuration against calibrated baseline
res = canard_comparison(airplane)
ap_base = res["baseline_airplane"]
ac_c = res["canard_airplane"]

hero_delta_ld = float(res["delta_ld_max"])
ld_canard_max = float(res["ld_canard_max"])
ld_base_max = float(res["ld_base_max"])
delta_x_np = float(res["delta_x_np"] * 1000)
delta_x_cg = float(res["delta_x_cg"] * 1000)
delta_cd_glide = float(res["trim_drag_penalty_at_best_glide_counts"])
delta_cd_thermal = float(res["delta_CD"][1] * 1e4)
sm_canard_pct = float(res["sm_canard"] * 100)
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{hero_delta_ld:+.2f}"`]{.hero-value}
[change in maximum trimmed glide ratio of canard configuration relative to baseline]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Moving the horizontal stabiliser forward as a lifting canard and removing the aft tailplane shifts the neutral point forward by [`{python} f"{abs(delta_x_np):.0f} mm"`]{.key} (@fig-canard-comparison). Maintaining [`{python} f"{sm_canard_pct:.0f}%"`]{.key} static margin requires ballasting the center of gravity forward by [`{python} f"{abs(delta_x_cg):.0f} mm"`]{.key}. Best trimmed glide ratio drops by [`{python} f"{hero_delta_ld:+.2f}"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{ld_canard_max:.2f}"`]{.key} compared to the [calibrated baseline](../01-calibrated-discus-2c/2026-09-30-01-what-does-a-discus-2c-geometry-reconstructed-from-published-data-look.qmd), reproducing the [exploratory analysis](../01-calibrated-discus-2c/2026-09-30-12-how-do-canard-glide-ratio-and-trim-drag-compare-with-the-baseline.qmd). Positive canard lift incurs a [`{python} f"{delta_cd_glide:+.1f}-count"`]{.key} trim drag penalty at best glide, surging to [`{python} f"{delta_cd_thermal:+.0f} counts"`]{.key} at thermalling speeds where high local angles of attack provoke canard stall.

```{python}
#| label: fig-canard-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Planform geometry layout and trimmed glide polar comparison between baseline and canard configurations across airspeeds."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

# Subplot 1: Planform geometry layout
w_main = airplane.wings[0]
y_m = np.array([xs.xyz_le[1] for xs in w_main.xsecs])
x_le_m = np.array([xs.xyz_le[0] for xs in w_main.xsecs])
x_te_m = x_le_m + np.array([xs.chord for xs in w_main.xsecs])

w_ht = ap_base.wings[1]
y_ht = np.array([xs.xyz_le[1] for xs in w_ht.xsecs])
x_le_ht = np.array([xs.xyz_le[0] for xs in w_ht.xsecs])
x_te_ht = x_le_ht + np.array([xs.chord for xs in w_ht.xsecs])

w_c = airplane.wings[1]
y_c = np.array([xs.xyz_le[1] for xs in w_c.xsecs])
x_le_c = np.array([xs.xyz_le[0] for xs in w_c.xsecs])
x_te_c = x_le_c + np.array([xs.chord for xs in w_c.xsecs])

fx = np.array([xs.xyz_c[0] for xs in fuse.xsecs])
fw = np.array([xs.width / 2.0 for xs in fuse.xsecs])
ax1.plot(fw, fx, 'k-', lw=1.2)
ax1.plot(-fw, fx, 'k-', lw=1.2)
ax1.fill_betweenx(fx, -fw, fw, color='gray', alpha=0.15)

for sgn in [1, -1]:
    ax1.fill(np.concatenate([sgn * y_m, sgn * y_m[::-1]]),
             np.concatenate([x_le_m, x_te_m[::-1]]),
             color='#1f77b4', alpha=0.25, label='Main wing' if sgn == 1 else "")
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_m, x_le_m, color='#1f77b4', lw=1.2)
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_m, x_te_m, color='#1f77b4', lw=1.2)

    ax1.fill(np.concatenate([sgn * y_ht, sgn * y_ht[::-1]]),
             np.concatenate([x_le_ht, x_te_ht[::-1]]),
             color='#7f7f7f', alpha=0.3, label='Baseline aft tail' if sgn == 1 else "")
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_ht, x_le_ht, 'k--', lw=1.0)
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_ht, x_te_ht, 'k--', lw=1.0)

    ax1.fill(np.concatenate([sgn * y_c, sgn * y_c[::-1]]),
             np.concatenate([x_le_c, x_te_c[::-1]]),
             color='#d62728', alpha=0.5, label='Lifting canard' if sgn == 1 else "")
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_c, x_le_c, color='#d62728', lw=1.5)
    ax1.plot(sgn * y_c, x_te_c, color='#d62728', lw=1.5)

ax1.plot(0, res['x_cg_base'], 'bo', markersize=6, label=f"Baseline CG ({res['x_cg_base']:.2f} m)")
ax1.plot(0, res['x_cg_canard'], 'ro', markersize=6, label=f"Canard CG ({res['x_cg_canard']:.2f} m)")

ax1.set_xlabel("Spanwise position y (m)")
ax1.set_ylabel("Fuselage station x (m)")
ax1.set_title("Planform Layout: Baseline vs Canard", fontsize=10)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.axis('equal')
ax1.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(True, linestyle=':', alpha=0.6)

# Subplot 2: Trimmed glide ratio polar
ax2.plot(res["speeds_kmh"], res["LD_base"], 'b-o', lw=1.8, label=f"Baseline (max L/D = {res['ld_base_max']:.1f})")
ax2.plot(res["speeds_kmh"], res["LD_canard"], 'r-s', lw=1.8, label=f"Canard (max L/D = {res['ld_canard_max']:.1f})")
ax2.set_xlabel("Airspeed (km/h)")
ax2.set_ylabel("Trimmed glide ratio L/D")
ax2.set_title("Trimmed Glide Polar", fontsize=10)
ax2.grid(True, linestyle=':', alpha=0.6)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
```
